acceptanceCriteria: Permission checking and requesting are separate typed transitions, with denied/unavailable states and resume recheck after Settings.

Daily summary is registered only when work exists; soak reminders are best effort; stable physical IDs prevent duplicates and support cancellation/reconciliation after restart, update and time-zone changes.
Android and iOS system pickers import user-selected photos/documents into app-owned storage without broad media permissions; restore completion triggers future-reminder reconciliation.

Crash reporting is release-default-on, persisted externally through the existing settings contract, runtime-toggleable, disabled in debug/tests/previews, and never includes Analytics, breadcrumbs, user identifiers or user-authored content.
Native user-visible copy is complete in default English and Russian resources; code contains no translated literals or app-specific locale override.

Ordinary Android/iOS builds require no Firebase secret; templates and exact setup instructions cover google-services.json, GoogleService-Info.plist, symbols and controlled test-crash verification without creating projects.
All shared behavior has deterministic common/host tests; macOS-only execution remains an explicit requested gate, not a claimed local result.
goal: Implement shared platform-neutral contracts, deterministic fakes, Android and iOS adapters/factories for notification permission and best-effort daily/soak reminders, restart/time-zone/replacement restore reconciliation, system photo/document picking and safe imported-file ownership, lifecycle resume rechecks, complete-erasure coordination, and privacy-minimized Crashlytics enable/disable behavior. Configure native resources/manifests/plists and safe Firebase templates/docs while keeping ordinary builds green with no secrets. Do not implement UI, persistence internals, ads, product analytics, or business schedule calculations.
